# Model fixture

`enclosure.glb.gz` is a gzip-compressed copy (mtime zero) of the enclosure GLB
fixture from [PoppyGL](https://github.com/tscircuit/poppygl/blob/b075498359493113bf42eb4648b18a18b3772d8b/tests/fixtures/assets/enclosure-fdm-box-usb-cutout.glb).
Compression reduces repository size; tests decompress the exact original bytes.
